ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_001: Zul’jin! Fallen pretender to a long-shattered throne! You sought to bring war upon my people but has brought naught but ruin to your misbegotten kind! Come forth, humbled beast, and answer for your crimes against the kingdom of Quel’thalas!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_002: Aaah. Da ‘high king’ of da elves himself be ‘gracing us’ with a visit to Zul’Aman. It be about time you climbed down from your high chair…King Sunstrider.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_003: You dared to mingle with vile foreign monsters, unleashing their savagery upon our forests and Silvermoon itself. But now, as it always is with beasts, they have scattered to the winds and left you to face our wrath alone… and for what you have done, there can be but one answer…
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_004: Our companions from the Alliance will deal with these brutes that yet remain at your side, mongrel, whilst the fury of the elves will be aimed at you alone. We seek not only your head, or the destruction of this pathetic claypit… we seek the end of your entire race, once and for all!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_005: I spit on your legacy and weakling fury, filthy elf! You stole our lands and den you dare call dem yours?! You think you got what it takes to exterminate us! Come den, false king, Zul’Aman will be your tomb!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S001_006: Very well then, avengers of Quel’thalas! Commence the siege!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S002_001: Warlord Zul’jin…that is a mighty host. I’m afraid my humble forces will not be enough to deter them.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S002_002: Don’t you worry none, captain Tharbek. You’re in our lands now. We will show you how we deal with dem weakling elves and their allies. Fall back to the city. I’ll call on your aid whenever I need it.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S003_001: Amani’shi! Da elves and their human ally scum have invaded our sacred homeland! Their bodies be yours to desecrate! For Zul’Aman!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S004_001: Warlord Zul’jin! Da elves be heading towards da temples, we must protect da avatars!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S005_001: You murderous beasts! I will take great pleasure in making you pay for what you have done!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S005_002: The Light always prevails against the heathens! We will smite these savages from the face of the earth!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S006_002: Felo'melorn! Rain fire and death upon the savages!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S006_003: Zul’jin! You must defend my temple! Fail me, and I will be unable bless you and your forces!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S007_001: Mighty Zul’jin! Da elves be desecrating my temple! Protect me, and my powers will be yours!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S008_001: Aman’ishi! Da elves will soon start their assault on our remaining temples. Be on your guard!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S009_001: Zul’jin! My forces are yours to command. Use them wisely, or we will be decimated!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S010_001: Warlord Zul’jin! Da elves be heading towards da remaining temples! Da avatars must be protected!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S011_001: Da invaders be sending stronger fighter now!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S012_001: Warlord! Da other troll tribes have offered their aid against da elves! You can hire their services from da Market!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S012_002: Good! It’s about time da trolls stand united against der common foe!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S013_001: Lok’tar ogar! Let the Alliance taste our steel one more time!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S013_002: Go you mangy dogs! Our troll allies need help!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S013_003: To the vanguard you slags! To the vanguard!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S014_001: Your crimes against the noble Windrunner family will not go unpunished, troll filth! I will present your head to Sylvanas and her sisters myself!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S014_002: Long have we enjoyed peace in our lands, but once again your miserable race has caused chaos and ruin… this will be the final time!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S015_001: Warlord Zul’jin! Da Elves be desecrating my holy temple! Aid me!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S016_001: Protect my temple, or you will lose my blessings!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S017_001: Tremble savages and despair! The full might of the high elves is unleashed upon thee!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S018_001: Warlord Zul’jin! Da elven king has destroyed da third temple! Only one temple remains!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S019_001: Bear witness to the might of Quel’thalas! Burn, you heathens, Burn!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S019_002: Protect my temple, or you will lose my blessings!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S020_001: Mighty Zul’jin! We have lost all the temples! We must fall back!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S020_002: Warlord! We can use our resources to further improve our weaponry and bolster our defenses against da elves!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S021_001: I’m the last orc standing. I never thought I’d die defending a land that is not my own.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S021_002: Your warriors fought bravely, Tharbek, and you have kept your word… and for that I release you from your oath. Go back to your Warchief and die well for your ‘Horde’… I pray dat the treason of your warlock has not doomed your cause…
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S021_003: Thank you…Warlord Zul’jin. I hope you have a plan to destroy this scum. Aka’magosh! May the spirits stand with you!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S022_001: Zul’jin! Our forces be nearly spent! We can defend this place no longer! We must fall back to the inner city and evacuate our brothers and sisters!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S022_002: Curse da elves and their human servants! Fall back! I have one last thing to do!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S023_001: Mighty and wise Ula’Tek! I call upon you! Protect your temple! Your city! Your people! Da elves will destroy us all if you don’t aid us! Lend me your power!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S023_002: Ahhh, young Zul’jin… I have witnesssssed your bravery. I will blessss ya. But da price be high... Your soul will never find resssst, you’ll seek vengeance against all who wronged da Amani!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S023_003: I accept da price, mighty Ula’Tek! May your powers bring death and terror upon our enemies!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S024_001: Aman’ishi! Da elves be gaining da upper hand! Show dem the might of our people and push dem back!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S026_001: Da Amani never gives up! Da Amani never surrenders! Da Amani never die!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S027_001: Our main strike force is in shambles, yet Zul’Aman’s defenses are almost broken! We... we have paid a heavy price to get here. I will prepare what’s left of our forces for the second siege. It is time to end this!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S027v2_001: Come taste the fury our gods! Be consumed in their name!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S027v2_002: Zul’Aman’s defenses are broken! The troll’s ferocity cost us a heavy price, but our main strike force remains. I will prepare our forces for the final siege. It is time to end this!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_001: We have paid a heavy price indeed, Lor’themar. I yearn to eradicate this blight upon the earth with every fiber of my being… yet the cost of this victory gives me pause. I would not rid the world of the Amani just to leave our kingdom defenseless against a second Horde onslaught… no more elves will die this day.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_002: But my king! We have them on the run! If we can just find Zul’jin and end him, it will leave his people scattered and easy to destroy. The end of our ancestral enemies is within our grasp!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_004: Mind your tongue, human! You’re addressing a commander in the Sun King’s host! You are oathbound to protect Quel’thalas… and as such you will follow our lead!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_005: Yes, our duty was to protect Quel’thalas… and protect it we have! Your lands are safe, and duty now calls us elsewhere.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_006: I just received word from Lord Turalyon that we must withdraw our forces back to Lordaeon immediately. The Horde is moving directly towards the capital! By the end of the day, we answer to Lord Lothar and the Alliance of Lordaeron, not some lordling who questions his king!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_007: Stand down, both of you! The general and his men have done enough! Return to Lordaeron with our thanks, general. I will send what forces I can spare to help defend your capital.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S028_008: As for the Amani… this battle has left them bloodied and weakened, they may never fully recover from this day. I will leave the Farstriders to deal with them at their earliest convenience. We will discuss this no further. We march home for Silvermoon within the hour.
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S029_001: Hey troll boss! I did not come here to die at the hands of those elves! I have plenty of toys that you can use to destroy their advances!
ToD_A03_M11S_VO_S029_002: Very good, little goblin! We’ll see what you’ve got!
